description: Sector overlay for civil associations, NGOs, foundations, donor-funded bodies, charities, cooperatives, and civil-society documentation in Togo.

metadata.scope: Togo-only sector overlay controls for NGO. Intended to be used with togo_core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis validated against Togolese and applicable regional legal/regulatory sources in force or officially current as of 2026-08-30. This rule pack remains a deterministic document-screening control set, not legal advice; qualified human review is required before reliance.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.

primary_sources.name: Current civil-association declaration and legal-recognition procedure
primary_sources.issuer: Togolese Republic / Service Public / Ministry of Territorial Administration

primary_sources.name: Decree No. 2022-002/PR and Interministerial Order No. 003/PR/MPDC/MEF on NGO-government cooperation and programme agreements
primary_sources.issuer: Togolese Republic / Journal Officiel / Service Public

primary_sources.name: Law No. 2019-014 on personal data protection
UMOA Uniform Law on AML/CFT/proliferation financing

limitations: Rules encode document-evidence checks, not a final legal determination.
Each rule requires validation against current Togolese laws, regional WAEMU/OHADA/CIMA instruments, regulator circulars, directives, codes and guidance before production reliance.
Automated results are screening signals only and require qualified human legal/compliance review.

rules.title: Association declaration, registration, or legal-recognition evidence is present
rules.summary: Checks for civil-association declaration, recognition, receipt, statutes, authorization, or registration-number evidence.

metadata.evidence_expectation: The reviewed document/document set should contain direct textual evidence for this control, or the engine should return missing/review_required according to the rule strategy.
metadata.review_guidance: A qualified Togolese legal/compliance reviewer must confirm applicability, current-law status, and legal sufficiency before relying on the automated result.
